name: Arkose Issy-les-Moulineaux voie

coord_source.ref: node 463549966 (leisure=sports_centre, Arkose Issy-les-Moulineaux, addr 1-6 Boulevard Garibaldi, phone and website match the gym page)

research_notes: Own page (read 2026-10-06): "Salle d'escalade de voie", hours Mon-Fri 9h-midnight and Sat-Sun 8h-midnight, "9 enrouleurs", "Autonomie en escalade de voie OBLIGATOIRE"; the body text never mentions a bouldering area. The page meta description says "le blocpark de l'ouest parisien. Escalade de bloc et de voie", which describes the Issy complex as a whole: the 200-block hall is the separate Arkose Issy-les-Moulineaux bloc (Rue du Bateau-Lavoir, Halle Guillaume, own page AKB). OSM node 463549966 carries climbing:boulder=yes next to climbing:toprope=yes (map data, not a primary source). The second pass could not settle whether the voie hall has any bouldering area. murmur.fr was not consulted (unreachable in the first pass).

name: Bloc Session Ardennes

coord_source.ref: Google Maps directions link on the gym's own contact page: .../maps/dir//Bloc+Session+Ardennes,+5b+rue+de+l'industrie,+08350+Donchery/@49.7062712,4.8735219,355m

research_notes: Own pages (2026-10-06): "La première grande salle d'escalade des Ardennes, climatisée, ouverte 7j/7", Bloc Session franchise, phone 09 86 38 41 03. Opened 19 July 2024 (ADT listing; PlanetGrimpe press release with address "5 rue de l'industrie 08350 Donchery D24", 500 m2 hangar in the industrial area, 80 blocks, a few rope routes). COORDINATE: no OSM element for the gym; BAN and Nominatim have no rue de l'Industrie in Donchery (the OSM street of that name is in Vrigne-aux-Bois). The only pin is the viewport centre of the gym's own Google directions link (49.7062712, 4.8735219), which lies on the D24 road at the north edge of Donchery, matching "D24" in the press release; salledescalade.com lists the same latitude (49.7062713) with longitude 4.8755 (about 140 m east). The ADT listing coordinates (49.69491, 4.874669) are the village centre (Place de la République), not the gym, and were not used. Pin is street-level (tens to about 150 m).
